items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: who happened to be the mother of the dancer Margaret Fontaine

ctx.x: Other than an interest in listening.

She was never . . . no I don’t . . . the only things I remember was Mummy always saying things like, “That’s very nice, dear.” In fact I remember one particular instance which shows where my character has gone. I guess, yeah, we were in Bromley . . . wait a minute, I’m just trying to locate the house and what was happening there. My mother had this friend who was her, one of her girlfriends, who happened to be the mother of the dancer Margaret Fontaine. She was Margot’s mother. Margot actually was . . . her name.…
Things do have a way of working in cycles, I believe.
